subcategories.title: Understand residenza, domicilio, and temporary residence
subcategories.titleIt: Capire residenza, domicilio e residenza temporanea
subcategories.whatIsIt: Understand which Comune procedure they actually need: residenza, cambio indirizzo, domicilio, temporary residence, certificate, or self-certification.
whyDoYouNeedIt: User says they need residenza but may only need a certificate
User is temporarily living in Torino
User moved from another Comune or abroad
User needs proof for ASL, EDISU, permesso, employer, bank, or another office
User does not know whether autocertificazione is enough
warnings: Do not route everyone directly to residenza.
If you only need proof for an Italian public office, autocertificazione may be enough.
If you are temporarily living in Torino without transferring habitual residence, temporary residence may be more appropriate.

subcategories.title: Change residence from another Comune or from abroad
subcategories.titleIt: Cambio residenza da altro Comune o dall’estero
subcategories.whatIsIt: This is for users who move to Torino from another Italian municipality or from abroad and want to register their residence in Torino.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Starting work or study in Torino
extraDocuments: Address details: street, number, apartment or unit, floor, staircase
warnings: Submit the declaration after actually moving into the home.
Comune di Torino states residence change after moving must be declared within 20 days.
Name on doorbell/mailbox matters because checks may fail if the person cannot be found.
False residence declarations can create legal problems.

subcategories.title: Change address inside Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: This is for someone already resident in Torino who moves to another address inside Torino.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Need updated address for documents, ASL, bank, employer
Need correct address for public-office communications
warnings: Use this only if the user is already resident in Torino.
If moving from another Comune or abroad, route to change_residence_from_another_comune_or_abroad.

subcategories.title: Temporary residence / popolazione temporanea
subcategories.whatIsIt: This is for people temporarily living in Torino who do not want or cannot transfer permanent residence.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Need administrative recognition without full residenza transfer
User is not transferring habitual residence
warnings: Temporary residence is not ordinary residenza.
Comune di Torino accepts request by email, PEC, or in person at Anagrafe Centrale by appointment requested by email.
Temporary population registration may not give the same certificates/rights as ordinary residence.

subcategories.title: Add name to doorbell / mailbox / address proof
subcategories.titleIt: Nome su citofono / cassetta postale / prova abitazione
subcategories.whatIsIt: Prepare for residence checks and proof of address.
whyDoYouNeedIt: User cannot prove they actually live there
Comune or police check may fail
warnings: This is preparation support, not a Comune submission by itself.
If residence request was already rejected/suspended, route to rejected_residenza_request_reply.

subcategories.title: Reply to rejected residenza request
subcategories.whatIsIt: Reply when Comune rejects, suspends, or asks for integration on a residenza/cambio indirizzo request.
extraDocuments: Any missing documents requested by Comune
warnings: Use PEC for formal integration/reply when possible.
If you do not understand what is missing, start with a normal email asking for clarification.

subcategories.title: Anagrafe certificate request
subcategories.whatIsIt: Request official demographic/anagrafe certificates.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Need certificate for private company or foreign authority
extraDocuments: Data of person certificate refers to
warnings: For many current certificates, ANPR is the fastest channel.
For many Italian public offices, autocertificazione may be enough.
Historical certificates may require specific Comune email/channel.

subcategories.title: Family status / stato di famiglia certificate
subcategories.whatIsIt: This is a specific certificate showing the people registered in the same family household.
extraDocuments: Delegation if requesting for another person
warnings: If the recipient is an Italian public office, autocertificazione may be enough.
Roommates are not automatically the same family household.

subcategories.title: Residence certificate / certificato di residenza
subcategories.whatIsIt: This certificate proves where a person is officially resident.
extraDocuments: Delegation if requesting for another person
warnings: For many Italian public offices, an autocertificazione may be enough instead of paying for a certificate.
If you are not officially resident at that address yet, the certificate will not solve the issue. Use the residenza or cambio indirizzo flow first.

richCategories.title: Work / INPS / Patronato
richCategories.shortDescription: Help users handle job-loss, NASpI, DID, Centro per l’Impiego, patronato appointments, INPS follow-up, rejected INPS requests, missing documents, employer end-of-contract documents, payslip/TFR problems, sick leave, family benefits, ISEE/CAF, and work-dispute support.
richCategories.mainUserQuestion: What work, unemployment, INPS, patronato, or employer problem do I have, and should I contact INPS, patronato, Centro per l’Impiego, CAF, union, employer, or send PEC?
richCategories.routingLogicSummary: First understand the user’s work situation: job loss, NASpI, DID/CPI, INPS request, rejected application, missing documents, employer documents, unpaid salary/TFR, sick leave, family benefits, ISEE/CAF, or work dispute. Then route to the correct flow and show only relevant documents, contacts, warnings, and generator buttons.
richCategories.topWarning: Start from the exact work or INPS problem so you can see the right office, documents, and next steps.

inpsTorinoDirezioneProvinciale.name: INPS Torino - Direzione Provinciale
inpsTorinoDirezioneProvinciale.warning: Use PEC for formal/protocol communication. For normal support, use INPS online services, contact center, appointment service, or patronato.

inpsTorinoSanPaolo.name: INPS Torino San Paolo

cgilTorino.name: CGIL Torino

subcategories.title: Understand job-loss and benefit situation
subcategories.whatIsIt: Use this page to understand which path applies after job loss, contract end, resignation, dismissal, apprenticeship end, or another work interruption.
whyDoYouNeedIt: You are asking about NASpI but may need to confirm the right eligibility path first
The job may have ended for different reasons
You may need employer documents first
You may prefer patronato support instead of applying alone through INPS
The employer issue may be a union or legal work dispute, not only an INPS matter
warnings: Do not promise NASpI eligibility without checking the reason the job ended and the contribution requirements.
If you resigned voluntarily, NASpI may not apply except in specific cases.
If the employer did not pay or the dismissal is disputed, move to union or legal work support.

subcategories.title: NASpI preparation
subcategories.whatIsIt: Prepare for the NASpI unemployment benefit application.
whyDoYouNeedIt: User wants to apply online through INPS
extraDocuments: Previous NASpI or INPS documents if any
warnings: For most users, patronato is safer than doing the application alone.
If the user resigned voluntarily, check carefully before NASpI.
If the employer ended an apprenticeship at the end of training period, verify with patronato/INPS.

subcategories.title: NASpI application follow-up
subcategories.whatIsIt: Check or follow up on a NASpI application already submitted.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Patronato submitted but user has no update
warnings: If a patronato submitted the request, first contact that patronato with protocol/receipt.
For formal INPS communication, include protocol number.

subcategories.title: DID and Centro per l’Impiego
subcategories.whatIsIt: Understand DID, employment availability declaration, and Centro per l’Impiego obligations.
whyDoYouNeedIt: NASpI requires availability to work and employment-service obligations
User must sign patto di servizio
User needs to reply to CPI message
warnings: Use correct CPI based on the user’s address, not automatically Torino Nord.
If the user has NASpI, do not ignore CPI/patto di servizio obligations.

subcategories.title: Patronato appointment request
subcategories.whatIsIt: Write to a patronato for an appointment.

subcategories.title: INPS appointment / contact request
subcategories.whatIsIt: Contact INPS or prepare an appointment request.

subcategories.title: Reply to rejected INPS request
subcategories.whatIsIt: Respond when INPS rejects or suspends a request.
extraDocuments: All missing documents requested by INPS
Proof of IBAN ownership if needed
warnings: If user is unsure, patronato first.
Use PEC/formal request only with protocol and clear attachments.
Do not promise reconsideration outcome.

subcategories.title: Missing documents integration
subcategories.whatIsIt: Send missing documents to INPS or patronato.
extraDocuments: All missing documents requested by INPS

subcategories.title: Employer termination / contract-end document checklist
subcategories.whatIsIt: Ask the employer for documents after the job ends.
warnings: If employer refuses or payment is missing, route to union/work dispute support.
For NASpI, patronato may tell the user which employer documents are really needed.

subcategories.title: Payslip / TFR / final payment problem
subcategories.titleIt: Problema busta paga / TFR / ultimo stipendio
subcategories.whatIsIt: When employer does not pay salary, TFR, ferie, permessi, or final settlement.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Contract ended but no final settlement
warnings: This is a work-dispute/payment issue, not only INPS.
If unresolved, recommend union/legal-work support.

subcategories.title: Sick leave / malattia INPS basics
subcategories.whatIsIt: This page explains basic steps for sick leave connected to work and INPS.
warnings: The doctor normally sends the certificate electronically.
Provide the protocol number to the employer if needed.
Address availability during illness matters for controllo medico fiscale.

subcategories.title: Maternity / family benefit help
subcategories.whatIsIt: This page routes users to patronato/INPS help for family-related benefits.

subcategories.title: ISEE / CAF connection
subcategories.whatIsIt: Understand when they need CAF instead of patronato.
warnings: ISEE is usually handled by CAF, not patronato.
If user needs an INPS benefit application after ISEE, route back to patronato/INPS.

subcategories.title: Union or legal-work dispute support
subcategories.whatIsIt: When the issue is not just INPS, but a work dispute.
warnings: This may require union/legal assistance.
UfficioFacile can help organize evidence and draft first messages, but does not replace legal representation.

subcategories.title: Understand student administrative problem
subcategories.whatIsIt: Understand which office is responsible for their problem.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Students often mix university, EDISU, Questura, CAF, Comune, ASL, landlord, and patronato
Each problem has a different channel and document checklist
The app should route before generating a message
warnings: Do not send every student problem to university office.
Scholarship/housing benefits usually go to EDISU.
Permesso problems go to Questura/university immigration support.
ISEE problems go to CAF/ISEE flow.
Healthcare/residenza/rental issues should cross-link to the specialized category.

subcategories.title: University office request
subcategories.whatIsIt: This helps the student write to the correct university office or open the correct ticket.
warnings: For PoliTO students, use Portale della Didattica / ticketing / Tool Prenotazioni first.
Use PEC only for formal institutional communication when appropriate.
Do not use random external emails unless the university page says they apply to the case.

extraDocuments: Translated/legalized/apostilled documents if required by bando

Use deadlines from the current EDISU bando as configurable data.
International students may need specific economic documents, translations, legalization, or apostille depending on country and bando.

subcategories.title: EDISU rejected request / missing documents
subcategories.whatIsIt: Reply when EDISU asks for missing documents, rejects a benefit request, blocks the application, or needs integration.

Do not promise the rejection will be overturned.

healthCategory.mainUserQuestion: How do I get the Tessera Sanitaria in Torino? Should I go in person, send PEC, send normal email, use an online service, or contact another office?

healthCategory.topWarning: For most first-time SSN / Tessera Sanitaria procedures in Torino, especially foreign citizens, students, workers, unemployed people, voluntary registration, domiciliation, STP, ENI, or complex cases, the safest method is to go in person to the ASL administrative office of the district where you live or have domicile. PEC is mainly for formal follow-up, rejected requests, missing documents, or complaints. Normal email is mainly for information and URP support.

subcategories.title: Italian citizen resident in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: For an Italian citizen resident in Torino, the practical need is usually to update the ASL position and choose a family doctor. If the user already has SSN coverage, they may only need doctor choice/revocation.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Use online services with SPID for doctor choice/revocation when possible. Otherwise go in person to the ASL administrative office of the district.
ASL administrative office of the Torino district where the user lives.
warnings: This flow is usually not about first receiving a codice fiscale card; it is about local ASL position and doctor choice.
If the user only needs duplicate/renewal, route to duplicate_or_renew_tessera_sanitaria.

subcategories.title: Italian student living in Torino but resident elsewhere
subcategories.titleIt: Studente italiano domiciliato a Torino ma residente altrove
subcategories.whatIsIt: For an Italian student who studies in Torino but is resident in another city or region, the practical need is usually temporary healthcare domiciliation and choosing a doctor in Torino.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to the ASL administrative office of the Torino district where the student lives.
ASL administrative office of the district where the student has domicile in Torino.
warnings: This is not simply duplicate Tessera Sanitaria. It is usually domiciliazione sanitaria.
The user may need to renounce the doctor in the residence area before choosing a doctor in Torino.

subcategories.title: EU student in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: EU students often use the European Health Insurance Card / TEAM from their home country for necessary healthcare. Full Italian SSN registration depends on eligibility and should be evaluated case by case.
whyDoYouNeedIt: For guidance, contact EDISU healthcare support. For ASL administrative evaluation, go to the ASL administrative office of the district where the student lives.
ASL administrative office of the student’s Torino district, if full local registration or domiciliation is needed.
warnings: EU student does not automatically mean full Italian SSN registration.
The app must distinguish between using TEAM, private insurance, and possible SSN registration.

subcategories.title: Non-EU student in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: A non-EU student in Torino usually needs either private health insurance or voluntary SSN registration. If they want SSN access and a family doctor, they normally need to pay the annual contribution and present the request at ASL administrative offices.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to the ASL administrative office with the voluntary SSN registration forms and payment proof. Use PEC only for follow-up or rejected requests.
ASL administrative office of the Torino district where the student lives.
extraDocuments: Valid permesso di soggiorno, or ask ASL if receipt is acceptable in the specific case
F24 payment receipt for voluntary SSN registration
Previous health insurance documents if relevant
warnings: Do not tell the user to only send PEC for first voluntary SSN registration.
Voluntary SSN registration is usually annual and expires on 31 December.
The payment is usually not divisible monthly and is not retroactive.
A valid residence permit may be required; if the user only has a receipt, ASL must evaluate the specific case.

subcategories.title: Non-EU worker in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: A non-EU worker with the correct stay/work status often falls under mandatory SSN registration, not voluntary paid student-style registration.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to the ASL administrative office of the district where the worker lives or has effective domicile.
ASL administrative office of the worker’s Torino district.
extraDocuments: Permesso renewal receipt if under renewal
Doctor choice form if choosing doctor at the same time
warnings: Do not route this user to voluntary SSN payment unless ASL says they are not eligible for mandatory registration.
If the ASL rejected the request for missing work proof, generate a PEC follow-up with the work contract attached.

subcategories.title: Unemployed person in Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: For unemployed users, eligibility depends on citizenship, previous work, DID/NASpI/Centro per l’Impiego registration, residence/domicile, and permit type.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to ASL with unemployment and previous-work documents. Use PEC if a previous request was rejected.
ASL administrative office of the Torino district where the user lives or has domicile.
extraDocuments: DID or Centro per l’Impiego registration if available
NASpI application or acceptance if available
warnings: Do not give one generic answer for unemployed people.
The app must first distinguish Italian, EU, and non-EU users.
For non-EU users, permit type and previous work are critical.

subcategories.title: Non-resident worker or student living in Torino
subcategories.titleIt: Lavoratore o studente non residente ma domiciliato a Torino
subcategories.whatIsIt: For users resident elsewhere but living in Torino for work, study, or health reasons, the practical flow is usually domiciliazione sanitaria.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go in person to the ASL administrative office of the district where the user has domicile in Torino.
ASL administrative office of the domicile district in Torino.
extraDocuments: Work contract or university enrollment certificate
warnings: This is not a simple card duplicate flow.
If domiciliation is requested for health reasons, the case may require medical-director evaluation and may not be immediate.
Temporary registration may depend on duration of work/study/health reason.

subcategories.title: Person without valid permesso di soggiorno
subcategories.titleIt: Persona senza permesso di soggiorno valido
subcategories.whatIsIt: A non-EU person without normal SSN eligibility should not be routed to ordinary Tessera Sanitaria registration. They may need STP support through Centro ISI.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Go to or contact Centro ISI ASL Città di Torino.
Centro ISI, Via Bazzi 19, corner with Lungo Dora Savona 24, Torino.
warnings: STP is not the same as normal Tessera Sanitaria.
STP is a temporary healthcare code for necessary healthcare access.
Do not route this user to normal voluntary SSN registration unless their legal status changes or ASL says so.

subcategories.title: EU citizen without Italian SSN or usable TEAM coverage
subcategories.titleIt: Cittadino UE senza SSN italiano o TEAM utilizzabile
subcategories.whatIsIt: An EU citizen without Italian SSN registration and without usable TEAM coverage needs case-by-case ASL or Centro ISI evaluation, especially if vulnerable.
whyDoYouNeedIt: If the user has stable work/residence conditions, go to the ASL administrative office. If vulnerable or without coverage, contact Centro ISI for guidance.
ASL administrative office of the Torino district, or Centro ISI if vulnerable/without coverage.
extraDocuments: Any proof of no healthcare coverage
Any TEAM/EHIC document if expired or unusable
Declaration of social fragility/indigence if requested
warnings: Do not automatically promise ENI.
The case must be evaluated by ASL/Centro ISI.

subcategories.title: Duplicate, lost, expired, or damaged Tessera Sanitaria
subcategories.titleIt: Duplicato, smarrimento, scadenza o danneggiamento Tessera Sanitaria
subcategories.whatIsIt: This is a separate later page for users who already have an SSN/codice fiscale position and only need a duplicate, renewal, or replacement card.
whyDoYouNeedIt: Use the national online services first when possible. If you cannot complete it online or there is a local issue, go to the ASL administrative office.
ASL administrative office of the user’s Torino district if online duplicate/renewal is not enough.
extraDocuments: Old card if damaged or expired
Delegation form if another person goes
warnings: This flow must not be the first Tessera Sanitaria page.
Only route here if the user already has a healthcare/tax position and needs card duplicate or renewal.

housingCategory.title: Housing / Rent
housingCategory.shortDescription: Help users in Torino handle rental contracts, landlord problems, deposit return, eviction risk, emergency housing, and tenant-union support.
housingCategory.mainUserQuestion: What rental or housing problem do I have, and who should I contact: landlord, Agenzia Entrate, Comune di Torino, PEC, normal email, tenant union, or lawyer?
housingCategory.routingLogicSummary: If the issue is about contract registration, RLI, contract change, cessione, subentro, proroga, or risoluzione, route to Agenzia Entrate. If the issue is about landlord conflict, repairs, deposit, expenses, or irregular contract, first generate a landlord message/PEC, then suggest SUNIA/SICET if unresolved. If the issue is about eviction or emergency housing, route immediately to Comune di Torino Sportello Casa / Emergenza Abitativa and tenant union support.
